services.name: Our Helicopters
services.desc: Originally designed by Bell Helicopter in the early-1970s to operate efficiently in extreme heat and high altitudes, these are the largest, most powerful single engine helicopters manufactured and operated in the world. With a maximum payload of up to 3,500kg (3.5 tons) these machines are the most productive and cost effective helicopters in their class. Seating is provided for up to 14 fully equipped passengers or crew.
